data.name: Shrinath
data.long_meaning: The abode of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, who is believed to protect his devotees and grant them prosperity.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies devotion and surrender to Lord Vishnu, who is considered the sustainer of the universe and the giver of prosperity and protection.

in_sanskrit.name: श्रीनाथ
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of wealth, God of prosperity, God of abundance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: श्री (Shree) - Goddess of wealth, नाथ (Nath) - God, Master. So, Shrinath means the God who is the master of Shree, the Goddess of wealth.

in_hindi.name: श्रीनाथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्री (Shree) - wealth, नाथ (Nath) - God, Master. So, Shrinath means the God who is the protector of wealth, the God who gives prasad (blessings), and the God who is full of prasad (blessings).

in_tamil.name: ஷ்ரீநாத
in_tamil.long_meaning: வழக்கை (Vazhakkai) - wealth, ஷ்ரீ (Shree) - Goddess, நாத (Nath) - God, Master. So, Shrinath means the God who is the master of Vazhakkai (wealth).

in_telugu.name: ష్రీనాథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: శ్రీ (Shree) - Goddess, శచేదు (Sachedu) - one who is full of, గోపాద (Go-padam) - the one who is at the feet of, దేశ (Dhesham) - God, master. So, Shrinath means the God who is at the feet of the Goddess of wealth, the God who is full of blessings, and the God who is the master of wealth.

in_marathi.name: Shrinath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Abenison of Lord Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shrinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The abode of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, who is believed to protect his devotees and grant them prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Shrinath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Abenison of Lord Vishnu
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shrinath একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The abode of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, who is believed to protect his devotees and grant them prosperity.

vedic_reference.note: Shrinath is a common name for Lord Vishnu and is also used for other deities like Shiva and Ganesha.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Shrinath" is derived from two Sanskrit words - "Shri" which means wealth, prosperity and blessings, and "Nath" which means master or lord. This name holds a great significance in Hindu culture as it refers to Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe and the provider of material and spiritual wealth. Temples and shrines dedicated to Lord Shrinath are common across India, and devotees visit them for worship, blessings, and to seek protection from Lord Vishnu.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Shrinath" carries a deep spiritual significance as it signifies the abode of Lord Vishnu, the Supreme Lord who is regarded as the sustainer and protector of the universe. Hindu scriptures and traditions teach that Lord Vishnu is the source of all existence, and seeking his blessings is essential for the spiritual growth and emotional well-being of every living being. By remembering and honoring Lord Shrinath, devotees hope to attain his grace, protection, and ultimate enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Shrinath is a name of Lord Vishnu in Hinduism. The name Shrinath carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Shrinath is a common name for Lord Vishnu in various temples and religious texts.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Shrinath remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Priya Shrinath in Chennai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Shrinath, which means "Abenison of Lord Vishnu". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Shrinath signifies the abode of Shri Hari, or Lord Vishnu. It is a reminder of the divine presence within, providing solace and a sense of protection. The name is a constant reminder of the journey towards spiritual growth and union with the divine.

seo.description_paragraph: Shrinath, a Hindu name, is a revered title for Lord Vishnu, the preserver deity in the Hindu trinity. The name signifies the abode of Lord Vishnu and represents the belief that he protects and grants prosperity to his devotees. Originating from Hinduism, Shrinath is a popular choice among devotees of Lord Vishnu, particularly in India and Nepal. Pronounced as ‘shri-nath,’ this name carries a rich cultural and religious heritage.
